info.text:
People guessed $86 a month on subscriptions. Itemized, it was $219.

In a 2022 C+R Research survey, the itemized total was 2.5x the guess: a $133 monthly gap, $1,596 a year.
Netflix's US Standard plan went from $8.99 (2014) to $19.99 (March 2026), up about 122%.
In Sept. 2025, Amazon agreed to pay $2.5B to settle FTC claims over Prime sign-ups and cancellations.

Sources: C+R Research (2022); Netflix via CNBC (Mar 2026); FTC/Amazon via CNBC (Sept 2025).
News and education, not financial advice.
